_doc: OPS-CLAUDEMD-CLAIM-VERIFIER-W1 — config for scripts/check-claudemd-claims.mjs, the verifier for the vault CLAUDE.md's machine-checkable assertions. Every exemption row carries its OWN `reason`: an exemption that lives only in prose gets 'fixed' by a future wave enforcing the contract. Missing or unparseable ⇒ CLAUDEMD_CLAIMS_VERDICT=INDETERMINATE, exit 3 — never a pass.
_corpus: The corpus is the vault CLAUDE.md (private, outside this repo). CI runners cannot read it, so the gate verifies the committed claim lock (ops/claudemd-claims.lock.json) — identifiers only, never the manual's prose. When the corpus IS reachable (operator Mac), the gate re-extracts fresh, enforces lock freshness by corpus sha256, and additionally verifies the local-only classes (vault paths, home paths). The manual's text never enters this public repo.
_step0_measurement: R1 measured 2026-08-02 on corpus sha 50920a2d…: 911 backtick spans; 22 _( … )_ correction blocks (8% of corpus chars) containing 60 spans. Raw would-fire on path classes WITHOUT the correction-block strip: 14 distinct (17 sites); WITH strip: 12 distinct. After the three measured classifier refinements (bare-directory spans are prose not claims; dist/** is build output never tracked by construction; absence/deprecated markers invert or skip the check), LIVE false positives on the blocking classes = 0, and the strip alone accounts for the historical `dispatch_schedule.py` + `dist/lib/x402.js` + paths-ignore-glob citations. Ladder assignments below follow that measurement, not intuition.

repo-path.note: Backticked concrete repo file (known prefix + extension, no glob/template chars, not dist/**). Verified against git ls-files. Measured FP after refinements: 0. Highest-frequency drift class (the /app/dist/index.js and lib/check-numerical-fact-density.mjs incidents).

root-file.note: Bare root filenames via root_file_map (deploy.yml → .github/workflows/deploy.yml). Measured FP: 0/19.

basename.note: Bare extension-bearing basenames resolved via the git ls-files basename join. Measured FP after template (XXXXXX) + DEPRECATED-marker refinements: 0.

wiring.note: ‘wired into X’ / ‘at `pre-push` by Y’ claims, resolved by IMPORTING check-canaries-wired.mjs's findInvocations — never a second implementation — then intersecting with wiring_point_map.

script-content.note: Exit-code and verdict-token claims: the named script must contain the claimed exit code / token. Grep-level association — promote on the numeric criterion below.

cron-schedule.note: `MM HH` pairs associated to a script on the same line, cross-checked against ops/monitoring/monitoring-inventory.json schedule (the committed SoT the daily reconciler asserts against the host — this gate never re-implements the host probe). Host state is operator-mutable → report.

env-var.note: NAME= tokens: the NAME must appear in ≥1 tracked file. Weak association → report.

absence.note: Claims marked DOES-NOT-EXIST/never-built/retired verify the INVERSE (must NOT exist). Precise but new — promote on the numeric criterion.

vault-path.note: Vault files (status.md, system-map.md, Claude files/…). Checked only when the vault is reachable; UNREACHABLE in CI is distinct from MISSING and never fires. First run found 3 true positives (all moved files).

host-path.note: /opt|/var|/etc paths. Probed read-only ONLY under --probe-hosts; default UNPROBED. /app/** is container-scoped and never probed. Never committed to the lock.

home-path.note: ~/… paths, existence-only (never read contents — admin.env is a secret store).

package-version.note: MEASURED EMPTY: the corpus's package mentions are historical pins (@x402/core 2.9.0→2.20.0, inside a correction block) or non-npm CLIs (mcp-publisher, caddy) — zero live npm-dependency claims to verify. Class deliberately unimplemented until one exists; revisit then, per the prompt's ladder.

glob.note: Glob patterns are pattern REASONING, not file claims — the deploy.yml paths-ignore lesson: the enumerated list was deleted in favour of pointing at the SoT. Enforcing globs would re-create that duplication.

prose.note: Spans with whitespace (commands), template placeholders (<…>, {NEXT}, X.Y.Z, XXXXXX), bare directory references, and bare symbol tokens. Measured 720/911 spans; verifying symbols would need an AST join with unbounded FP surface — out of scope v1.

report_class_promotion.criterion: A report class promotes to block only after ≥30 consecutive --check runs (CI + local combined) with ZERO false positives in that class, counted from the gate's own printed per-claim output — a number that can be checked, not a vibe. The flip is a config edit owned by OPS-CLAUDEMD-CLAIM-PROMOTE-W{NEXT}; do not flip it inline.

_repo_prefixes_note: hooks/ is deliberately absent: the corpus's `hooks/pre-push` refers to the AOE repo's hook, and cqsm tracks no hooks/ (measured) — including it would be a permanent false positive. dist/ is absent because build output is never tracked by construction (the tsc-emits-per-module law explains why greps there mislead).
_wiring_point_map_note: Entries ending in / or _ are PREFIXES. pre-push resolves through the per-gate hook installers (scripts/install_*_hook.sh — measured: session-drift and source-greppable each ship their own), the baseline gate script, or the vitest suite the pre-push hook runs (tests/).

exemptions.reason: Redaction-STRUCTURE example in the secret-redaction law (‘mask everything after LABEL=’) — a placeholder, not an environment variable any script reads.
Per-wave OUTPUT template name (waves produce audits/<wave>-endpoint-truth.md in this repo — several exist); there is deliberately no vault-root file of that literal name.

Editorial-host artifact (/opt/algovault-editorial) cited in the Hashnode-DEPRECATED law; it never had a committed ancestor in this repo, and the deprecation context makes it a status claim, not an existence claim.

aoe-1 instance of monitoring-inventory-reconcile.py. Live-verified 2026-08-02 on the aoe host crontab (`17 7 * * * MONITORING_HOST_LABELS=aoe-1 …`); its inventory row lives in the AOE repo's vendored copy (OPS-AOE-MONITORING-PARITY-W1), so this repo's inventory legitimately cannot confirm it.
